caption: Expedo: Screencast for app review. The app UI is in English (Romanian is the second language); captions explain each step.
1 · Install: Install on a development store, approve access, pick a plan (no charge on development stores), then open Expedo from Apps.
2 · Dashboard: After install, the dashboard shows what to do today: orders to process, orders needing attention, parcels on the way and cash on delivery.

3 · Test mode: The store is in Test mode (yellow banner): AWBs and invoices are test documents, couriers and invoicing apps are not called, Shopify is not changed. Settings → General also sets the language.
4 · Couriers: Five couriers: Cargus, Sameday, FAN Courier, GLS, DPD. On a live store you paste the API credentials and click “Test connection”.
4 · Couriers: Reviewers: in Test mode no account is needed. Click “Save” with empty fields, then “Use as default”.
5 · Invoicing: SmartBill, FGO or Oblio are set up the same way. The invoice is issued together with the AWB, or only manually.
6 · Rules: Rules choose the courier per order: easybox orders go to Sameday, heavy orders get two parcels, large cash-on-delivery orders wait for a check.
7 · Orders: Orders with a problem are stopped before any courier call. Each problem says what is wrong and what to do.
8 · Address fix: Order #1115 has no county (“The county is missing.”). Pick it from the list and save: the address is checked again.
8 · Address fix: Order #1116: FAN Courier does not know the locality “Volutari”. Expedo suggests “Did you mean: Voluntari, …?” from the courier’s list.
8 · Address fix: Type the right locality and save. The change stays in Expedo; the order in Shopify is not modified.
9 · AWB + invoice: “Create AWB + invoice” creates the AWB at the courier and the invoice. In Test mode both are test documents.
10 · Bulk: Open “Ready to process”, select the orders and click “Create AWB + invoice” once for all of them. Order #1111 is flagged: this customer refused a parcel before.
10 · Bulk: Done: every order has one AWB and one invoice. Clicking again never creates a second AWB or invoice for the same order.
11 · Labels: “Labels” opens one PDF with every label, A6 or A4. In Test mode the labels are marked as test labels.
11 · Picking list: “Picking list” adds up the products to pick for the selected orders, ready to print.
12 · Tracking: Parcels are checked every 30 minutes, or on demand with “Check parcels”.
12 · Cash on delivery: A delivered cash-on-delivery parcel is marked “collected”. On a live store the order is also marked paid in Shopify.
12 · History: Every step is in the order history: import, AWB, invoice, tracking, delivery, cash collected and payment recorded on the invoice.
13 · COD export: “COD export (CSV)” exports cash-on-delivery amounts per parcel, to check courier payments.
14 · Automation: Optional automatic processing for new orders. Temporary courier errors are retried after 1, 5, 15, 60 and 180 minutes.
15 · Go live: When ready: switch to Live. Real AWBs and invoices; the order is fulfilled in Shopify with tracking and the customer gets Shopify’s shipping e-mail.
